verses: Boht ba-barkat hai woh (Allah) jiss kay hath mein badshahi hai aur jo her cheez per qudrat rakhney wala hai
Jiss ney maut aur hayat ko uss liye peda kiya kay tumhen aazmaye kay tum mein say achay kaam kaun kerta hai, aur woh ghalib (aur) bakhshney wala hai

Jiss ney saat aasman upper talay banaye. (to aey dekhney walay) Allah rehman ki pedaeesh mein koi bey bey-zaabtagi na dekhay ga, doobara (nazren daal ker) dekh ley kiya koi shigaf bhi nazar aaraha hai
Phir dohra ker do do baar dekh ley teri nigah teri taraf zaleel (o aajiz) ho ker thaki hui lot aaye gi
Be-shak hum ney aasman duniya ko charaghon (sitaron) say aaraasta kiya aur unhen shetanon kay maarney ka zariye bana diya aur shetanon kay liye hum ney (dozakh ka jalanay wala) azab tayyar ker diya
Aur apney rab kay sath kufur kerney walon kay liye jahannum ka azab hai aur woh kiya hi buri jagah hai
Jab uss mein yeh dalay jayen gay to uss ki baray zor ki awaz sunen gay aur woh josh maar rahi hogi
Qareeb hai kay (abhi) ghussay kay maaray phat jaye, jab kabhi uss mein koi giroh dala jaye ga uss say jahannum kay daroghay poochen gay kay kiya tumharay pass daraney wala koi nahi aaya tha?
Woh jawab den gay kay be-shak aaya tha lekin hum ney ussay jhutlaya aur hum ney kaha kay Allah Taalaa kuch bhi nazil nahi farmaya. Tum boht bari gumrahi mein hi ho
Aur kahen gay agar hum suntay hotay ya aqal rakhtay hotay to dozakhiyon mein (shareek) na hotay
Pus unhon ney apney jurum ka iqbal ker liya. Abb yeh dozakhi dafa hun (door hun)
Be-shak jo log apney perwerdigar ghaeebana tor per dartay rehtay hain unn kay liye bakhsish hai aur bara sawab hai
Tum apni baaton ko chupao ya zahir kero woh to seenon ki posheedgi ko bhi bakhoobi janta hai
Kiya o hi na janey jiss ney peda kiya? Phir woh bareek been aur ba-khabar bhi ho
Woh zaat jiss ney tumharay liye zamin ko pust o mutee kerdiya takay tum uss ki raahon mein chaltay phirtay raho aur Allah ki roziyan khao (piyo) ussi ki taraf (tumhen) ji ker uth khara hona hai
Kiya tum uss baat say bey khof hogaye ho kay aasmano wala tumhen zamin mein dhansa dey aur achanak zamin laraznay lagay
Ya kiya tum uss baat say nidar hogaye ho kay aasmano wala tum per pathar barsa? Phir to tumhen maloom ho hi jaye ga kay mera darana kaisa tha
Aur unn say pehlay logon ney bhi jhutlaya tha to dekho unn per mera azab kaisa kuch hua?

Kiya yeh apney upper per kholay huye aur (kabhi kabhi) sametay huye (urney walay) parindon ko nahi dekhtay, unhen (Allah) rehman hi (hua hawa-o-faza mein) thamay huye hai. Be-shak her cheez uss ki nigah mein hai
Siwaye Allah kay tumhara woh kaun sa lashkar hai jo tumhari madad kersakay kafir to sirasir dhokay hi mein hain
Agar Allah Taalaa apni rozi rok ley to batao kaun hai jo phir tumhen rozi dey ga? Balkay)yeh (kafir) to sirkashi aur bidaknay per arr gaye hain
Acha woh shakhs ziyadah hidayat wala hai jo apney mun kay bal ondha ho ker chalay ya woh jo seedha (pairon kay bal) raah raast per chala ho?
Keh dijiye kay o hi (Allah) hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya aur tumharay kaan aankhen aur dil banaye tum boht hi kum shukar guzari kertay ho
Keh dijiye! kay o hi hai jiss ney tumhen zamin mein phela diya aur uss ki taraf say tum ikatthay kiye jao gay
(kafir) poochtay hain kay woh wada kab zahir hoga agar tum sachay ho (to batao?)
Aap keh dijiye kay uss ka ilm to Allah hi ko hai, mein to sirf khulay tor per aagah ker denay wala hun
Jab yeh log uss waday ko qareeb tar paalen gay uss waqt unn kafiron kay chehray bigar jayen gay aur keh diya jaye ga kay yehi hai jissay tum talab kiya kertay thay
Aap keh dijiye! acha agar mujhay aur meray sathiyon ko Allah Taalaa halak kerdey ya hum per reham keray (bahar soorat yeh to batao) kay kafiron ko dard-naak azab say kaun bachaye ga?
Aap keh dijiye! kay o hi rehman hai hum to uss per eman chukay aur ussi per humara bharosa hai. Tumhen unqareeb maloom ho jaye ga kay sareeh gumrahi mein kaun hai?
Aap keh dijiye! kay acha yeh to batao kay agar tumharay (peenay ka) pani zamin mein utar jaye to kaun hai jo tumharay liye nithra hua pani laye?
